name: Minnie Belle McPhail (Weidkamp)
milestones: Married Theodore "Ted" Weidkamp (m. 1898, Whatcom County, Washington)
sources: Family research emails, 2011–2013 (John and Barbara Adams with Irma Kulp Zacher, George F. Adams, Bill Allen and others)
notes: One of the four McPhail girls born in Memphis. She and Ted witnessed her sister Mary's marriage to John Kulp. They had seven sons, among them Theodore Milton Jr. (m. Nellie), Harold (m. Cena), Willard (m. Anne), Ervin (m. Mae), Vernon (m. Lois) and Ira. [Family research emails, email 48]

Open question: Irma says Minnie and Ted Weidkamp had 7 sons but names only six (Theodore Milton Jr, Harold, Willard, Ervin, Vernon, Ira); the following 'Beryl (Lois)' may be the seventh son or a misplacement [Family research emails, email 48]
